classification.difficultyReason: Plot four explicitly supplied ordered pairs on a given Cartesian grid using horizontal-then-vertical coordinate conventions.

content.prompt: Plot these points on the Cartesian plane.

spec.description: Authored Cartesian response grid accommodating all four coordinates.
spec.mathematics: Unit grid from -11 to 11 on each axis.

answer.worked: Move 4 units left and 2 units up from the origin; mark $A$.
Move 3 units right and 10 units down from the origin; mark $B$.
Move 9 units right and 8 units up from the origin; mark $C$.
Move 7 units left from the origin; mark $D$ on the horizontal axis.

spec.description: Complete answer graph shared by all four point responses.
